name: qihoo_360_ads-mcp
display_name: 360 点睛营销平台 360 Ads MCP
description: 360 点睛营销平台 360 Ads (ads): me, get_report, update_budget, pause_resume. Every tool maps to a document

platform_mcp_qihoo_360_ads_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_QIHOO_360_ADS_API_KEY
platform_mcp_qihoo_360_ads_api_key.description: ApiKey e-mailed after the open.e.360.cn developer application is approved; sent as the `apiKey` HTTP header on every call.

platform_mcp_qihoo_360_ads_encrypted_pas.title: PLATFORM_MCP_QIHOO_360_ADS_ENCRYPTED_PASSWORD
platform_mcp_qihoo_360_ads_encrypted_pas.description: clientLogin `passwd`: AES-CBC(MD5(password)) with key = first 16 characters of the ApiSecret and IV = last 16, as 64 lowercase hex characters (身份认证: '秘钥是apiSecret 的前16位，向量是后16位'). It is a fixed value, so compute it once with 360's official 'openAPI登录接口AES调试工具' or its code samples; the password itself is never needed. Five wrong logins lock the account until the next day.

tools.name: me
tools.description: POST uc/account/getInfo (headers apiKey + accessToken) → uid, userName, balance, budget … of the logged-in account.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: POST dianjing/report/campaign (form startDate, endDate, type=all, page) — settled campaign report, at most 90 days and up to yesterday (ready after ~08:30 Beijing time; error 70109 before that), 1000 rows per page. The account is the logged-in one (`account_id` is not sent) and `campaign_id` is not a documented filter. spend is totalCost in CNY.

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: POST dianjing/campaign/update (form id, budget): budget is the campaign's daily budget in whole CNY (0 = unlimited; a fractional amount is rejected before sending). This changes spend. `currency` is ignored.

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: POST dianjing/campaign/update (form id, status=pause|enable). Resuming restarts spend.
